summary: Iter226 (backend only, read-only): validated /app/scripts/export_sku_bom.py against MongoDB and public download endpoint. All 9 pytest cases pass. Script runs cleanly and produces 4 sheets (DETAIL_BOM, RINGKASAN_SKU, RINGKASAN_MODEL, KETERANGAN). Row counts match DB exactly (model=104, RINGKASAN_SKU=665 = 645 varian + 20 model tanpa varian, DETAIL_BOM=2174). All 645 variant SKUs appear exactly once in RINGKASAN_SKU and >=1 in DETAIL_BOM. Status assertions verified: DA-2201-* (Ona) TANPA_BOM, DA-1101-BRG-ALLSIZE BOM_TANPA_AKSESORIS, DA-1101-CRL-ALLSIZE BOM_LENGKAP with baris_aksesoris=4, 30 SKU nonaktif -> BOM_NONAKTIF, 20 model tanpa varian -> TANPA_SKU dengan kolom sku kosong. Sample 5 baris DETAIL_BOM BOM_LENGKAP: kode_material/qty/satuan/qty_dasar/harga_per_satuan_dasar cocok dengan rahaza_boms.materials, biaya_baris = qty_dasar x harga_per_satuan_dasar, harga_master_saat_ini = rahaza_materials.unit_cost. RINGKASAN_MODEL distribusi status persis 20/1/2/1/18/56/6 (A/B/C/D2/D/E/F) - identik dengan output laporan_kekosongan_bom.py. Public download GET {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/downloads/EXPORT_SKU_BOM_DA.xlsx -> HTTP 200 dan valid dibuka openpyxl dengan 4 sheet yang benar.
